gloss: protective wall; barrier wall; defensive fence

definitions.gloss: protective wall; barrier wall; defensive fence
definitions.explanation: A wall or fence built to protect against wind, noise, fire, or other hazards. Used in construction, urban planning, and general descriptions of protective barriers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{工事|こうじ}{現場|げんば}→工事現場：26202_koujigenba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{防塀|ぼうへい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設置|せっち}した→設置する：26989_secchisuru⟧。
examples.english: A protective wall was installed at the construction site.

examples.japanese: {防塀|ぼうへい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{騒音|そうおん}→騒音：03315_souon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧だいぶ⟦{軽減|けいげん}→軽減：16954_keigen⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Thanks to the barrier wall, the noise was considerably reduced.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{備|そな}えて→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{防塀|ぼうへい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦{農家|のうか}→農家：03539_nouka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many farmers built protective walls around their houses in preparation for typhoons.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{防|ぼう}→防〜：03967_bou⟧ (to prevent, to protect against) and ⟦{塀|へい}→塀：03613_hei⟧ (wall, fence). Part of the productive ⟦{防|ぼう}→防〜：03967_bou⟧+ noun pattern for protective barriers (⟦{防壁|ぼうへき}→防壁：24431_bouheki⟧, {防風|ぼうふう}{林|りん}, etc.). Refers to a physical structure built for protection rather than a natural barrier.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {防塀|ぼうへい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設置|せっち}する→設置する：26989_secchisuru⟧: to install a protective wall
- {防塀|ぼうへい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{建|た}てる→建てる：01189_tateru⟧: to erect a barrier wall
- ⟦{防音|ぼうおん}→防音：14565_bouon⟧{防塀|ぼうへい}: soundproof barrier
- {防塀|ぼうへい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{囲|かこ}む→囲む：02037_kakomu⟧: to surround with a protective wall

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{塀|へい}→塀：03613_hei⟧: wall, fence — a general enclosing wall around a property
- ⟦{防壁|ぼうへき}→防壁：24431_bouheki⟧: defensive wall, rampart — often used figuratively or for larger fortification-style walls
- {防風|ぼうふう}{林|りん}: windbreak forest — trees planted as a natural wind barrier
